releaseNotes: Expands the offline original-language word-study library from 100 to 110 contextual lexemes, adding Greek studies of mercy, compassion, godliness, reconciliation and atonement, and Hebrew studies of comfort/relenting, Sabbath, remembrance, dwelling and shield imagery. Each entry includes original script, contextual glosses, verified KJV references and explicit limits on unverified verse-level parsing.
